The §6Solar Tower Boiler§r is a steam-generating machine that uses the power of the Sun to boil steam passively during the day. It only has two slots, one for input and one for output. It can only heat Water into Steam.

First, place §6Heliostat Mirrors§r around the Boiler in valid areas such that they are not too close to the Boiler. Place the Boiler high up, around §b6-§r§b8§r blocks. The maximum range is up to 100 blocks.

Then, use a §9Mirror Adjustment Tool§r, by Sneak Right-Clicking the Boiler and Right-Clicking each of the Heliostat Mirrors. This links the Mirrors to the Boiler, allowing them to reflect light towards the Boiler and thus heat it.

The boiler consumes §7§61 mB§r§r of water for every §612.5 §rmirrors each tick at full sunlight level, and §6100 mB§r of steam per mB of water consumed. 

The amount of Steam generated §cdiminishes§r during noon and§4 stops completely§r during nighttime or if it is raining. Thus, it is recommended to use a §6Battery Socket§r to provide backup energy during the night.

You can calculate the amount of §6Steam§r generated by an N amount of Mirrors at the §cNTM wiki§r, here:

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Solar_Tower_Boiler[/url]
